responsibility: Implements translation of GIMPLE from SSA form back to normal form before expansion. It decides which SSA definitions can be replaced directly, inserts strategic backedge copies to avoid critical-edge splitting when possible, eliminates useless PHIs, builds and solves PHI copy-coalescing/elimination graphs, coordinates temporary expression replacement and partitioning with tree-ssa-coalesce/tree-ssa-ter, and emits the copy structure needed to materialize non-SSA variables and later RTL pseudos.
same_name_distinction: Implements the out-of-SSA translation declared in gcc/tree-outof-ssa.h. Unlike the header’s shared ssaexpand state and accessors, this file performs PHI elimination, backedge-copy insertion, replaceability checks, coalescing coordination, and emission of the copies needed to leave SSA form.
